final: WITH state_totals AS (SELECT c.state_county_province, SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS state_total FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.account_id = ft.account_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), overall AS (SELECT SUM(state_total) AS overall_total FROM state_totals), shares AS (SELECT st.state_total * 1.0 / o.overall_total AS share FROM state_totals AS st CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_total IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), kept AS (SELECT s.share, av.avg_share FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS av WHERE av.avg_share IS NOT NULL AND s.share > av.avg_share) SELECT (SELECT SUM(st.state_total) FROM state_totals AS st WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kept)) AS total_state_transaction_amount, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS average_difference_from_average FROM kept
